label: Update Content
description: Applies the event's patch to the resource this step acts on, changing only the fields listed here that its node type declares. The same list describes the form that offers the change.

fields.label: Field
fields.description: The properties a change may set, in the order the form shows them, each stored as a node named after its property.

label.label: Label
label.description: What the form calls the field. Left blank, the property's name.

help.label: Help
help.description: A line the form shows under the field.

multiline.label: Multiline
multiline.description: Whether the form offers several lines of text.

referenceType.label: Reference type
referenceType.description: For a reference, the resource type the referenced content must have.

referenceRoot.label: Reference root
referenceRoot.description: For a reference, the path the referenced content is looked for under.

unique.label: Unique
unique.description: Whether no two siblings of the same type may hold the same value in the field.

choices.label: Choice
choices.description: The values the field allows. None allows any.

label.label: Label
label.description: What the form shows for the value. Left blank, the value itself.

appliesWhen.label: Applies when
appliesWhen.description: Offers the field only while another property holds one of some values. Left out, it always applies.
